reasons: The same session file is used for every F1 session.
Paths depend on the starting folder.

terms.meaning: a saved sample data file used for testing or demos

sections.name: File setup, json
sections.title: File reading setup
sections.what: Brings in file reading and decompression tools and sets the data folder as the root for all reads.
sections.why: Likely reason: the Desk loads its recorded data from files.
sections.watch_out: The root is based on the current working folder, so the app must start in the project folder or the data will not be found.

sections.name: cricketReplays
sections.title: Cricket replays
sections.what: Lists the cricket match files in the cricket folder, sorted by name, and returns each with its raw data and a reference from its file name.
sections.why: Likely reason: each file holds one recorded match.

sections.name: footballReplays
sections.title: Football replays
sections.what: Reads the football match list once, then loads each compressed event file and returns it with the match list and a reference taken from its number.
sections.why: Likely reason: football event files are compressed to save space.
sections.watch_out: The reference is taken from the first number in the file name, so a file without a number gives an empty reference.

sections.name: f1Replays
sections.title: F1 replays
sections.what: Reads the lap data and creates one replay per session key, each paired with the same race session file.
sections.why: Likely reason: the session file is shared, so one copy is reused.
sections.watch_out: Every F1 replay uses the same 2023 race session file, whatever session it belongs to. This looks unintended and should be checked.

sections.name: outcomeModel
sections.title: Outcome model file
sections.what: Loads the saved win probability model, which carries a version and a fingerprint.
sections.why: Likely reason: the Desk needs the model that produces swing numbers, and its version and fingerprint appear as receipts.

summary: Reads recorded match data and the outcome model from files in the data folder.
purpose: Loads the replay files the Desk uses.
why: Likely reason: the Desk runs on stored recordings rather than a live feed.
how: 1. Find files in each sport's folder. 2. Read and decompress them. 3. Return each with a reference taken from its file name. 4. Load the outcome model file.
outputs: Raw match data with references, and the model.
risks: Paths depend on where the app is started. Every F1 session uses the same session file.
debug: If the Desk is empty, check the data folder path and file names. If F1 looks wrong, check the session file.
